indicator.name: Food-insecurity risk (E168 LightGBM): probability that the province is HIGH
indicator.definition: Forecast probability that the share of households with moderate or severe food insecurity (FNRI HFIAS) in the province is 50% or more (HIGH). E168 starts from the latest published provincial survey level and adds a constrained LightGBM forecast of the change, from the five trigger groups (market and prices; climate; employment and OFW remittances, both national series; and fish kill, measured by the proxy of provincial fisheries production change, not by fish-kill event records), with news signals inside each group. Poverty and density are also inputs and weight the city and municipal ranking. HIGH at 0.50.
indicator.horizon: issued 2026-10-01; Lead 1 = 2027-Q1, Lead 2 = 2027-Q2, Lead 3 = 2027-Q3. Leads 1-3 meet the project acceptance rule (accuracy >= 75% and better than the latest survey).
indicator.source: FNRI NNS/ENNS provincial HFIAS (2013-2021); PSA provincial CPI, LFS, poverty, production and population; BSP remittances; PAGASA/NOAA climate; IBTrACS; news (XLM-RoBERTa events, BERTopic topics)
indicator.caveat: A forecast risk class, not a measured food-insecurity rate. It was validated on 72 provincial forecasts from 3 survey rounds (2018, 2019, 2021): accuracy 75.0% at one quarter ahead against 62.5% for the latest survey alone. It tends to over-predict by about 3 points (about 2 in 5 HIGH calls were false alarms) and rarely misses a HIGH province.

forecastTarget.rule: next calendar quarter after the one in which the dashboard is viewed (Asia/Manila); forecasts are issued at the start of the current quarter with information published before it

quarterRange.note: Backtests are observed quarters. The current quarter and the next calendar quarter (the dashboard's target) are forecasts issued at the start of the current quarter with information published before it; neither outcome is known yet.

forecast.name: One-quarter-ahead forecasts (lead 1)
forecast.question: What did the served LightGBM estimate one quarter ahead, using only information released before the quarter began?
forecast.definition: aiPHeed-E36-LGBM estimates of P(S1 = H + 2D above its trailing-median threshold) one quarter ahead: development backtests 2023-Q1..2026-Q3 (refitted at each origin, nested selection) and the 2026-Q4 forecast frozen at origin 2026-10-01. News evidence is the previous quarter's. Not validated: no baseline is beaten significantly (E36).

nowcast.name: Latest estimate per quarter
nowcast.question: What is the best available estimate for each quarter, including the one under way?
nowcast.definition: The E36 model issues no same-quarter nowcast: every quarter, including 2026-Q4, shows its one-quarter-ahead (lead 1) estimate, labelled with its mode.
